title: No-Show Charge on Missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
## The charge — Specimen Collection Appointments

A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit recorded as a no-show — the patient was not there when the phlebotomist arrived — carries a no-show charge. The no-show charge on a home visit recorded as missed is worked out by calculation rather than as one flat fee. It is posted on the missed visit as one assessed no-show fee, dated the day it is posted; the patient then sees an assessed no-show fee owed on the missed visit. A visit carries at most one no-show fee.

## Posting tool: `assess_no_show_fee_12606755`

**Capability.** Posts the no-show charge on a home collection visit that was recorded as missed. One call adds one assessed no-show fee line, dated today, to the visit's collection-service fee record and raises the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance by that amount.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_no_show_fee_12606755` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `visit_id` — identifier: the reference number of the missed collection visit to charge, read from the visit lookup for the patient.
- `fee_amount` — fixed format: the no-show charge to post, in USD, a positive amount given to 2 decimal places (cents); the value is posted exactly as given, already rounded to the cent.

**Return.** A receipt with `visit_event_id` (the reference number of the new assessed no-show fee line), `visit_id` (the visit charged), `fee_type` (always `no_show_fee`), `fee_amount` (the amount posted in USD to 2 decimal places), `event_date` (today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `fee_balance` (the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance in USD after posting). A receipt carrying a `visit_event_id` means the charge is on the visit.

## Basis Q&A

**Which visits carry the charge?** A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit whose status is no-show.

**What does the posted line look like to the patient?** An assessed no-show fee on the missed visit, owed until settled.
